v0.6.0.description:
## Changes from v0.6.0-pre.2 and v0.5.4
- This is a complete rewrite of hydra's code to be far cleaner and more organized
- Most features were moved, check the readme for a list of the features
- Text Client and Player List got a huge rework
- For now Hint Organizer and Location Checklist haven't been moved
  - v0.6.0-pre.2's spoiler log reader didn't move either, but something is in the works
- Can import settings (sadly multiworlds will not move over)
- New features include:
  - An auto updater
  - More customizability related features
  - UT support

## Changes from v0.6.0-beta.16
- Added an Autoupdater setting for updating to beta versions (off by default)
- Fixed a visual bug with 'stopping' slots while they are connecting
- Added the button animation to more (hopefully all) buttons
- Added a setting to change the background stretch mode b/t stretch and tile
- Added a hint (?) hover tooltip info for line edits in the settings
- Hopefully fixed a strange index out of bounds bug with circle tracker
- Inventory item list now updates when images are reloaded
- No longer writes log files if there are no errors

Follow the [readme](https://github.com/SWCreeperKing/HydraTextClient_Rewrite/blob/master/README.md) for instructions and feature list
